name: CFM-DSS GeoServer (geohorr/ChennaiDSS WFS)
cadence: monthly re-census; plus per NEM activation
notes: 344 feature types enumerated; 343 readable anonymously, 1 auth-walled; 26 empty at source, 5 OWS failures; no license, no docs. Re-census command + expected output in DATA-CATALOGUE.md §6 (expect 344 while unchanged, verified 2026-10-03). Big pulls need CQL_FILTER + pagination.

name: CFM-DSS dashboard AJAX APIs (chennaifloodmonitor.tn.gov.in/Master/*)
notes: ~60 endpoints, no published API reference. Session-bound: plain HTTP clients get HTTP 403 (re-confirmed 2026-10-04 on GetPublishAlert) — needs the front-end's own session cookie + anti-CSRF header, i.e. replay via a scripted browser session. Never bypass auth; call only what the site's own front-end calls.

name: CFM-DSS GetPublishAlert — public alert feed
cadence: daily (cheap; highest-value monitor on the beat)
notes: Zero rows on every check to date. The first non-empty response during NEM 2026 is the strongest single piece of evidence this desk can obtain — capture the raw payload, hash it, and pull the matching bulletin.

name: CFM-DSS rain-panel endpoint GetRainfallDatafordashboard
notes: One call per district (5). The panel is the flagship 38-station view. Freshness = the per-station date_time field, NOT row presence — year-old rows still render as data. Station set has been stable 38/38 since 2026-09-29. Raw dumps kept under data/chennai-floods/probes/.

name: CFM-DSS bulletin host (image-only PDF bulletins)
notes: Seven bulletins exist in total, all from the Oct-2025 activation; archive ends 2025-12-02 and none has been published since. Image-only PDFs, no text layer. Watch item G7 — the first new bulletin is a beat event.

name: World Bank Documents & Reports API — project P179189 (TNCRUDP)
cadence: quarterly; plus each TN assembly session
notes: Keyless WDS API works. 14 project documents + 2 procurement plans archived under docs/wb/. Loan/Financing Agreement for IBRD-96250 NOT yet disclosed via WDS — recheck the project page's Official Documents tab quarterly; its contract annex is the natural RTI-companion ask.

name: TNUIFSL fund pages (PDGF / TNUDF)
notes: Primary source for the PDGF grant layer: non-lapsable TA fund, operational 1 Apr 2015; 2023-24 receipts ₹35.23 cr, disbursements ₹52.64 cr across ALL assignments — RTFF & SDSS's ₹107.2 cr is ~2 years of the fund's entire disbursement capacity. No versioning or archive on the site: capture screenshots/PDF each visit. Portal misspells the fund as "Project Development Grand Fund" on AboutUs.

name: Tamil Nadu e-procurement portal (tenders)
notes: Search the RTFF contract IDs (IN-TNUIFSL-350974-GO-RFB, -351017-CS-CDS, -385194-CS-CDS, -375180-CS-CDS) plus keywords RTFF / flood forecasting / RTDAS / AMC. Quirks: ASP.NET postbacks, captcha, award notices PDF-only. This is where a replacement for the vanished $6.06M RTDAS package would surface first.

name: Media corpus — RTFF/SDSS/IFMC success-impact claims (TN press + X)
notes: Living register: MEDIA-CLAIMS.md (27 entries, claim-typed T1-T7). Method: web+X sweep dated in the file. Thin layer: Tamil outlets (Dinamani, Daily Thanthi, Dinamalar, Hindu Tamil Thisai) — extend per season. IFMC watch: log every mention; note which system officials credit during each event.

name: Wayback Machine — chennaifloodsdss.in (dead predecessor portal)
cadence: on each story move toward draft
notes: Portal is NXDOMAIN; last capture 2025-08-31. Use the CDX API before quoting any archived URL, and re-check for new captures annually. The desk's Dec-2023 rescue (chennai-rain-gauges, 287 layers) is the only surviving mirror.

name: Hugging Face mirror — CashlessConsumer/chennai-flood-* (5 datasets)
cadence: on each re-mirror (annual; plus per activation)
notes: The desk's own open release; data home for every artifact a claim cites (transactions, GIS layers, flood history, bulletins, predecessor rescue). Pin dataset revisions when a claim leans on them; lastModified re-verified 2026-10-03 via HF API.

name: CAG of India — Tamil Nadu audit reports
cadence: annual report cycle + each TN assembly session
notes: Search for TNUIFSL / PDGF / RTFF mentions; reports are PDF-only and indexed late. CAG has never audited the flagship per the desk's scans (to confirm in next cycle) — the ₹71 cr → ₹107.2 cr jump with no public revision trail is the natural CAG-ask.

name: RTI lane — rtionline.gov.in (TN has no state RTI portal)
cadence: as RTI drafts are dispatched (target: one per week from 2026-10-06)
notes: Public authorities to file against: WRD (PWD), TNUIFSL, TNSDMA/CRA, GCC. Ready targets (REPORT §5.6): GoTN sanction order(s) under PDGF; PDGF utilisation certificates naming RTFF; SECON-JBA JV contract value + payment schedule; what happened to IN-TNUIFSL-350974-GO-RFB; IIT-M oversight agreement; AMC schedule per station layer. Fee ₹10, first-appeal route documented in the portal itself.
